content: Yehoba I Ba Nopalegi Hagalena Nihi Ginol
Itipita elana Yehoba i baek Mosese ge Eloni eliyalil i ola,
“Waikena ya nuku teli baliman ana waikena houwan.
Nu ba boda Isileli elal: Waikena ya ana lan elulutega elana, tau maisena ge maisena sipi natuna o ebo goti natuna ni hile wana limi ana heniheni kaiweliya.

Ebo tau etega wana limi ana heniheni nige nihi gegewi ge nige bosowailiya bwasumu bwabwaligena nihi an haba, inoke avaliyau ge wali heliyamwau bolo labeliyaa nihi an livaso. Nuku golugoluwa gamagal ali gewi elana ge toto i bosowaina gamagal maisena ge maisena ni an ana luvi.
Sipi o ebo goti melutauil nuku hilel, wali baliman maisena, tuwaliya sasapona.
Nihi matahikagil bubun ana siga waikena houwan ana lan potin-ina (14-ina) vekokoyavi, yaka boda Isileli gegewel bwasumu bolo o nihi lolil.
Saliyana enuna nihi ahe inoke nihi abutek limi toto hi anana ana nog kokowanaa ge ana ai labi labui elana.
Bulin toto o bunumwina nuku ton inoke nuku an ginebi awenuwa hohogana ge pwalawa nige alona yis hi vivikuhiya.
Bahi kolena o ebo liligana nuku an, yaa tuwana gabomwina gegewena, balomana, aena ge elokena, nuku ton ni mola bubun inoke nuku an.
Bahi ginolina etega nuku aan teli ge mweluluga ni pwapwawa. Ebo ni gan, inoke nuku ton ginaha elana ge ni wai.

He wami aanan ana logugui i ola hiwe. Ami kaliko nuku hipwa bubun, aemiu aana nuku pahe, ge wami suki nuku pihikan nimamiwa yaka bosowaimiu egon. Ge nuku aanan pwamweyaha. Nopalegi Hagalena to nau Yehoba kaiweu.
“Bulin toto o Itipita na nosolaan, yaka gamagal ge bwasumu gamaun melutauil na lolil, inoke yabowaineyau bolo Itipita hi kululuek elal alaliya na teli lowan. Nau Yehoba.

Saliya toto nog kokowanaa ge ana ai labi labui elana ni tabwa limi toto ku miminaa ali etotohi. Sauga saliya na kite, inoke na nopalegemiu. Inoke sauga toto Itipita na lolil, logabola nanakina ya komiu nige nuku pwapwawa.
“Lan ya nuku nuwahikan, yaka eliyana heyan ge heyan hagali nuku ginol nau Yehoba o nuwahikan kaiwena. Ami logugui o ni mihot.

Pwalawa toto nige alona yis hi vivikuhiya nuku an lan ali gewi seben. Lan houwan elana, yis gegewena nuku bugul yohil wami limiya, kaiwena lan houwan ana siga lan seben-ina ebo etega pwalawa toto alona yis hi vivikuhiya ni an, iya nuku ahek yoho boda Isileli gamwanaa.
Lan houwan i ola al lan seben-ina nuku nogogo ge nuku tapwalolo. Lan bolo ya bahi tuwalali, iyai te amiu nuku ligaliga.
Pwalawa toto Nige alona Yis Hi Vivikuhiya Hagalena nuku ginol, kaiwena lan o gegewemiu ya nul tagilagimiu Itipita. Heyan ge heyan hagali toto e ana nuwahikan nuku ginol. Ami logugui o ni mihot.
Inoke waikena houwan ana lan potin-ina kokoyavi ana siga lan tuwenti wan-ina (21-ina) kokoyavi, pwalawa toto nige alona yis hi vivikuhiya nuku an.
Inoke lan seben bahi yis ni gagan wami limiya. Ebo towoho o ebo bwabwali etega pwalawa toto alona yis hi vikuhiya ni an, iya nuku ahek yoho boda Isileli gamwanaa.
Hauna labi nuku minaa, pwalawa toto nige alona yis hi vivikuhiya nuku anan. Bahi pwalawa toto alona yis hi vikuhiya nuku aan.”
Nopalegi Hagalena Houwan

Yaka Mosese Isileli wali tonowakau i yogaagil ge i baek elal i ba, “Maisena ge maisena nuku nok sipi o ebo goti natuna nuku hile alomiyau natumiyau kaiwemiu, yaka nuku tagapaaliga Nopalegi bwasumona kaiwena.

Bwasumu saliyana nuku hol mwaha elana, yaka mwawin alana hisopa nuku pikin ge nuku pahunek saliya ana mwaha gamwanaa, inoke nuku abutek wami limi ana nog kokowanaa ge ana ai labi labui elana. Bahi etega nuku tatagil limiya ana siga mweluluga.
Sauga Yehoba ni nosola Itipita ni lolil, he saliya ni kite nog kokowanaa ge ana ai labi labui elalil, yaka limi ni nopalegi. Yaomal ana Anelose nige ni uulutuk wami limiya ge ni lololimiu.
“Logugui ya ni mihot, inoke sauga gegewena alomiyau ge tubutubumiyau nuku henapuan.
Sauga nuku tuka panuwa toto Yehoba i bateli ni pewa eliyamiu, yaka nuku ginol ni ola to.
Sauga ebo natumiyau nihi nel nihi ba, ‘Hagali ya puna ga i ola?’

yaka analiya nuku lahe nuku ba, ‘Nopalegi Hagalena te Yehoba ta nuwahikan, kaiwena valila Itipita elana Isileli wala limi i nopalegel, yaka Itipita i lolil ge kila i pwamolola.’” Mosese wana baaba o Isileli hi hago, yaka hi loepwakoku ge hi tapwalolo.
Inoke hi ginol i ola Yehoba wana baaba Mosese ge Eloni elal.
Gamaun Hi Aliga ge Isileli Itipita Hi Eguluwan
Bulin nuwana, Yehoba Itipita ali gamaun melutauil i lolil gegewel hi aliga, i telipunaa kin towasawasa natuna elana i na ana siga todibula natuna. I ola al bwasumu ali gamaun gegewel hi aliga.
Bulin o, kin alonau ana tolabe ge Itipita gegewel hi kenu lut. Yaka kahin bwabwatana i masala Itipita, kaiwena limi maisena ge maisena aliga nige i kakala.
Bulin maisena o elana, kin Mosese ge Eloni i yogaagil ge i baek elal i ba, “Nuku egon! Alomiyau ge Isileli no panuwa ku eguluwan! Ku na ku tapwalolo Yehoba elana ni ola wami awanun elau.
Wami sipi, goti ge bulumwakau nuku ahel ni ola wami baaba, yaka nuku egon. He nuku awanun al Yehoba ni muloluagau.”
Itipita Isileli hi patotoel etimwawa wali panuwa nihi eguluwan ge hi baek elal hi ba, “Ebo nuku mina, nasi naha aliga haba!”
He pwalawa iyaka hi pahun, yaa nigeya ga yis hi tetelek, inoke ginebi ana etuwalali hi bugulan, kaliko elana hi osiya ge hi kalivai.
Yaka Isileli hi ginol ola valila Mosese wana baaba elal, hi na tuwan ana isela gold ge silba ginebi ge kaliko waiwaisana hi awanunil Itipita elal.
Yehoba Itipita ateliya i pameimei Isileli hi awatauwagil, inoke wali bugubugul hi pek elal i ola wali awanun. Yaka Isileli Itipita wali gogomwau hi bugul egonan.
Yaka Isileli Lamesese hi tataluwan hi na Sukot. Bolau ali gewi i ola sikis handeled tausan (600,000), yaa yowau ge wawayau nige hi vavasilel.
Gamagalau getogal hi gewi avaliyau Isileli hi egonan. Isileli wali sipi, goti ge bulumwakau ali yawi bwabwatal hi ahel avaliyau hi tagil.

Pwalawa nige alona yis hi vivikuhiya toto hi pwatanem Itipita, hi ahe hi ton ali beleid. He ali pwalawa nige ga alona yis hi vivikuhu, kaiwena Itipita hi patuna owaowa-agil inoke nige wali sauga ge aliya nihi lovivina-an bubun.
Isileli wali minamina Itipita elana baliman ana gewi po handeled ge teti (430).
Baliman po handeled ge teti ana lan mowamowasena elana te Yehoba wana gamagalau ali un gegewel hi tagilem Itipita.
Bulin o Yehoba i silawa ge i nulil tagilagil Itipita. Inoke baliman maisena maisena bulin toto o Isileli heyan ge heyan nihi silawa Yehoba ana nuwahikan kaiwena.
Nopalegi Hagalena ana Logugui Enuna
He liwanina i ola to. Yehoba i baek Mosese ge Eloni elal i ba, “Nopalegi Hagalena ana logugui i ola hiwe. “Bolo nige boda Isileli i oola bahi nihi aan.
He wami totuwalali loloyowanina toto iyaka ku pwamola bosowaina ni an, ebo tuwana buhuna kunisina iyaka ku tomwa yoho.
Yaa tonawanawa ge totuwalali molana gaganina bolo sauga kaukaubwana ya hi miminaa gamwamiwa, bahi nihi aan.
“Nopalegi Hagalena bwasumona maisena nuku anana limi maisena gamwanaa. Bahi ginolina etega nuku tatagilan limi o tolinaa ge bahi tutuwana etega nuku gagabom.
Boda Isileli gegewel hagali ya nihi ginol.

“Bwabwali toto i miminaa wami panuwaa, ebo nuwana Nopalegi Hagalena ni ginol Yehoba ana awatauwan kaiwena, he bolau gegewel wana limi ana heniheni gamwaliyaa gotomwa yoho paganina nihi ahe. Ebo ni ola o, inoke bosowaina hagali enowana ni anan ni ola Isileli towohina hot. Yaa bolo nige gotomwa yoho paganina hi aahe, bahi nihi aan.
Towoho ge bwabwali bolo hi miminaa wami panuwaa, ami logugui i maisena ya.”
He Isileli gegewel hi ginol ola Yehoba wana baaba Mosese ge Eloni eliyalil.
Yaka lan o eliyana Yehoba Isileli ali un i nulil tagilagil Itipita.
